model_specification_coverage.provenance_boundary: Specifications are thesis transcriptions; they are not asserted to be byte-exact executed model files.

public_data_boundary: Study-related PDFs, source archives and de-identified tables are deposited. Filenames and participant IDs do not establish anonymisation or release consent; consult replication/docs/DATA_PROTECTION.md and the study access notices.
public_artifact_scope: six separately retained model instances under generated-artifacts/chapter5-technical-validation/model-instances
six retained text run records with metadata and quantitative summaries
six checksum lists identifying files in retained local run directories
reported metric transcriptions and provenance documentation
questionnaire instruments, study material and access guidance
deposited datasets or dataset reconstruction/provenance documentation
independent reference workflows and portfolio applications
replication_limitations: Original generated sources, point-level predictions, complete logs and full historical run directories are not all deposited.
A full-run checksum list is not the same as a deposited run directory with independently verifiable files.
Thesis-transcribed specifications, retained execution records and synthetic reference workflows have different provenance.
Dataset-specific provenance and correction notes must be checked before attempting numerical reproduction.
